# The settings style update bridges legacy button variables to new state tokens

The patch uses button-hover-background-color and button-active-background-color for affected controls, while panel-item still assigns its legacy property names from those values. Fixed accepted variables retain aliases from the old hover/active names to the new state tokens. The applications row consumes the hover token and uses a direct transparent border-color outside hover/focus. These are scoped CSS contracts, not a global rename rule or a rendered pre-Nova appearance guarantee.

Scope: Thunderbird settings button-state CSS compatibility.
